selection: Each deployed combination must pass its role fresh confirmation and its separate native role confirmation (researcher suite itself is native; suggestion matches production tool-free context and deadline measurement). Shared base may change only if exact selected combinations that include it pass every applicable role. Otherwise only individually passing role changes with original base can ship. Never combine separately passing edits without confirming the combination.
costUncertainty: Publish paired-family total-token intervals, cached input, output/reasoning, request/tool rounds and latency. The point token-saving gate is local; intervals and authored native/service gaps limit deployment claims. No universal optimality or representative-user sampling claim.
stop: One broad conservative rewrite class and one targeted local-deletion class for coordinator/researcher. No further semantic tuning or fresh-family replacement after confirmation failures; retain deployed prompts when gates fail. Source/fixture bugs require whole affected comparisons invalidated, never selective grade relaxation.
provenance: Author-frozen cases and candidate designs separated; blind Luna High rubric review plus independent source/grade audits, not independent human ground truth.
